description:
Verify that signal_enrichment modules are properly wired into signal_analyser and that scores flow to mcp_signal_enrichments table.

MUST: Query mcp_signal_enrichments for presence of all 8 signal types (domain_trust, tool_description_safety, permission_scope, supply_chain, community_signal, temporal_stability, supply_chain_enrichment, community_signal_enrichment).
MUST: Check that each enrichment row has evidence_blob with signal_type and confidence fields per spec contract.
MUST: Report distinct scores per signal_type to verify discrimination quality.
MUST: Flag any signal_type missing from mcp_signal_enrichments as wiring gap.
Signal discrimination quality: supply_chain (34 distinct), community_signal (33 distinct), domain_trust (11 distinct) are OK. permission_scope (3), temporal_stability (3), tool_description_safety (3) are WEAK -- may indicate wiring issue or enrichment needs review.
Read-only diagnostic; no DB writes.
